name: FACET — AI Assistant (context → knowledge → generate → handoff)

meta.note: Generic conversational assistant for any facet. Webhook -> load transcript from the state store -> retrieve knowledge (GET {{FACET_KNOWLEDGE_URL}}?q=) -> one OmniRoute call with a facet system prompt -> parse STRICT JSON {reply, capture, needs_human} -> reply via FACET — Channel Send -> persist transcript + capture. Answers only from knowledge; degrades to a neutral human handoff. The generic form of the CREA assistant. Copy, set the {{FACET_*}} vars, register.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: '{{FACET_LLM_MODEL}}', temperature: 0.3, response_format: { type: 'json_object' }, messages: $json.messages }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ key: $node['Parse AI'].json.from, capture: $node['Parse AI'].json.capture, transcript: ($node['Build Prompt'].json.transcript || []).concat([{ role: 'user', content: $node['Parse'].json.text }, { role: 'assistant', content: $node['Parse AI'].json.reply }]).slice(-12), lastInboundAt: new Date().toISOString() }) }}

value.text: ={{ 'Needs a human \u2014 ' + $node['Parse AI'].json.from + ':\n' + JSON.stringify($node['Parse AI'].json.capture, null, 2) }}
